title: Polish Pork Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful Polish-inspired dish featuring pork and a nutty crust.

ingredients.name: Casserole dish
ingredients.notes: Not an ingredient, but required for cooking

instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to a casserole dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the cubed Polish rye bread and cook until toasted.
Sprinkle the toasted bread over the pork in the casserole dish.
Drizzle the melted butter over the bread and sprinkle with dried thyme.
Season with salt, pepper, and brown sugar to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes or until the pork is cooked through.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before serving.
